scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "pnpm --filter @uni/api dev" "pnpm --filter @uni/web dev" "pnpm --filter @uni/worker dev"
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @uni/shared build && pnpm --filter @uni/config build && pnpm --filter @unicodeit/uni-mail build && pnpm --filter @uni/api build && pnpm --filter @uni/worker build && pnpm --filter @uni/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @uni/shared build && pnpm --filter @uni/config build && pnpm --filter @unicodeit/uni-mail typecheck && pnpm --filter @uni/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @uni/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @uni/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && tsx scripts/mail-connectivity.test.ts && tsx scripts/sending.test.ts && tsx scripts/imap-sync.test.ts && tsx scripts/webmail.test.ts && tsx scripts/auto-read.test.ts && pnpm test:module6 && pnpm test:module8 && pnpm test:module9 && pnpm test:module10 && pnpm test:module11 && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:module13
scripts.db:generate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @uni/database exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @uni/database exec prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @uni/database exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:status: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @uni/database exec prisma migrate status --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.perf:test: pnpm --filter @uni/config build && pnpm --filter @uni/api build && pnpm --filter @uni/worker build && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/perf/module14.mjs run
scripts.recovery:test: pnpm --filter @uni/config build && pnpm --filter @uni/api build && pnpm --filter @uni/worker build && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/perf/module14.mjs run --recovery
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @uni/database exec prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.retention:dry-run: pnpm --filter @uni/config build && pnpm --filter @uni/worker build && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/retention.mjs --dry-run
scripts.retention:run: pnpm --filter @uni/config build && pnpm --filter @uni/worker build && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/retention.mjs --run
